summary: Sawyer County, WI tower that the AHI dates to 1932 and FFLA lists as standing; staffing, fire history and public access not found.

events.note: AHI gives year built 1932 and a May 1932 newspaper lists Clam Lake as already completed in District 7. A Sept 13, 1933 item (Oshkosh Daily Northwestern) says the foresters were overseeing an 80-foot tower under construction, and its credit line names CCC Company 1604 at Camp Beaver; it names no site, so unresolved.

notes_for_editor: Identity of the 80-foot tower is unresolved. The 1933 Oshkosh item names no site; the Central US and clamlakewi pages place it under Clam Lake, and the 1932 completion report and AHI date this tower to 1932. facts.height_m 24.4 comes from that 1933 item and the record, so treat it as probable, not confirmed. Status 'standing' rests on the FFLA list and a 2016 local post; no recent visit or photo was found. The AHI record (survey 1985, not demolished, Forest Rd 208 in its location field) is the strongest official record. No staffing list, fire history, ownership or access information was found. Used 1 web search and about 6 page reads.
